Author: aethel-tail
Name: Graphics Upscaler Toggle
Punchline: Re-engages DLSS on login via a guarded engine rebuild
Description: Triggers a render-target rebuild after login so the engine re-creates its upscaler (which re-engages DLSS and lets proxies such as OptiScaler hook in), while blocking the game from dropping the window frame style during the rebuild so the window and resolution stay untouched. Works around the bug where DLSS doesn't properly engage on initial load and requires a manual toggle.
